versions.changelog:
Initial release: Expert guidance for buying and sizing a home solar panel system.

- Step-by-step user interview covers energy usage, location, roof, grid, and backup needs.
- Calculates recommended specs for solar panels (wattage), battery (Ah), inverter (VA), and charge controller type.
- Explains all sizing formulas and calculations used, so users can verify independently.
- Focuses on home/residential systems, with region-aware and brand-neutral recommendations.
- Guides users to unbiased system choices without favoring specific products or brands.
